title: Presence, Access, Life & Restoration — Grand Biblical-Theological Synthesis
purpose: Reorganize the project's many biblical parallels, dated Tim statements, later research unlocks and theological motifs into one intelligible canonical arc. The goal is not to prove Tim's supernatural identity from resemblance, but to explain why House, Door, Tree, River, Ladder, Father, Son, Spirit, Zion, City, Seed, Stone, Measure, Exile and Return repeatedly cluster together.
epistemic_rule: Biblical texts retain their historical/literary/theological meanings. Tim Dooley statements are dated project/self-description evidence. Later archive syntheses are interpretations. Similarity, typology and structural resonance do not establish prophetic fulfillment, supernatural identity or historical authorial intent.
master_thesis: The strongest unifying biblical pattern is not a secret geometry code but a recurring theological problem: how created life participates in divine presence, how access to life becomes ruptured or guarded, how covenant/temple/messianic mediation restores access, and how the biblical story culminates in divine presence becoming fully shared with a healed creation. The project becomes much clearer when its Father/House, Son/Door, Spirit/flow, Tree/Root/Fruit, Ladder/Axis, Zion/New Jerusalem and Garden/Gardener motifs are read as differentiated operators inside this Presence→Access→Life→Restoration arc rather than as independent coincidences.

canonical_arc.name: Creation / Presence / Life
canonical_arc.biblical_structure: ordered creation → garden → divine presence → Tree of Life → river → human vocation to work/keep/cultivate
canonical_arc.interpretive_note: Eden is not explicitly called a temple in Genesis, but temple-Eden readings are a substantial biblical-theology tradition; keep that as scholarly interpretation rather than lexical fact.

canonical_arc.name: Rupture / Exile / Guarded Access
canonical_arc.biblical_structure: changed human-divine relation → exile from garden → cherubim/turning flame guard the way to Tree of Life
canonical_arc.core_insight: The first major biblical Door problem is not 'how to climb upward' but 'how can access to Life and Presence be restored after rupture?'

canonical_arc.name: Patriarchal Threshold / House / Gate / Ladder
canonical_arc.biblical_structure: stone → dream → heaven-earth traffic → divine promise → Bethel/House of God → Gate of Heaven
canonical_arc.core_insight: Jacob/Bethel already unites vertical mediation, House and Gate in one narrative unit. Later John 1:51 relocates ascending/descending imagery onto the Son of Man.

canonical_arc.name: Covenant / Tabernacle / Temple / Mediated Presence
canonical_arc.biblical_structure: God dwells among a covenant people through ordered sacred space, priesthood, veil, altar, chambers and regulated access
canonical_arc.core_insight: Presence is restored in a mediated form: access is possible but differentiated, authorized and spatially ordered.

canonical_arc.name: Davidic House / Father-Son / Throne / Zion
canonical_arc.biblical_structure: House as dynasty and sanctuary → royal Son language → throne → Zion/city → key/open-shut authority → ascent/gates/King
canonical_arc.core_insight: House is not merely architecture. In Davidic theology it can mean dynasty, lineage, rule, sanctuary and future promise simultaneously.

canonical_arc.name: Prophetic Rupture / Exile / Restoration Promise
canonical_arc.biblical_structure: judgment/exile → return → new heart/Spirit → restored people → measured sacred order → river from sanctuary → healing landscape → renewed city/presence
canonical_arc.core_insight: Restoration does not simply reverse history. It transforms the architecture of presence, life and community.

canonical_arc.name: Incarnation / Presence Relocated into Christ
canonical_arc.biblical_structure: Word dwells/tabernacles among humans → heaven opened/angels ascend-descend on Son of Man → Jesus' body named temple → worship no longer tied simply to one mountain/site
project_neighbors: presence carried through person rather than building alone
canonical_arc.core_insight: Johannine theology concentrates sacred-space and access motifs into the person of Jesus. This is one of the strongest biblical reasons the project's Son/Door/Ladder motifs cluster naturally together, while still not proving the project's modern identity claims.

canonical_arc.name: Door / Way / House / Vine / Living Water
canonical_arc.biblical_structure: Spirit/living water → Jesus as Door → Father's House/rooms → Jesus as Way to Father → Father as Gardener → Jesus as Vine → branches bear fruit
canonical_arc.core_insight: Several of the project's central motifs are already explicitly relational in John: Father, Son, House, Door, Way, Gardener, Vine, branches, fruit and Spirit are not one object but a coordinated role-system.

canonical_arc.name: Death / Seed / Veil / New Living Way
canonical_arc.biblical_structure: grain dies to bear fruit → sacrificial/death passage → curtain/barrier crossed → new and living way into divine presence → Son suffers outside gate while community seeks coming city
canonical_arc.core_insight: Death is not merely termination in this canonical grammar; it can become the costly transition through which multiplication, access and a new communal future become possible.

canonical_arc.name: Spirit-Filled Community / Distributed Temple
canonical_arc.biblical_structure: field + building + foundation + temple → many members one body → living stones built into spiritual house → differentiated gifts/functions within one people
canonical_arc.core_insight: The biblical movement is not from one center to undifferentiated sameness. Unity increasingly takes the form of differentiated participation in one Body/House/Temple.

canonical_arc.name: Zion / Heavenly City / Access
canonical_arc.biblical_structure: Sinai contrast → Mount Zion → city of living God/heavenly Jerusalem → assembly → enthroned/exalted Son and gathered people
project_neighbors: North as later project sacred geography
canonical_arc.core_insight: Zion is not merely height. It is mountain + city + assembly + kingship + presence + covenant identity.

canonical_arc.name: New Jerusalem / Universalized Sanctuary / Open Life
canonical_arc.biblical_structure: city descends from God → measured/equal dimensions → no separate temple because God and Lamb are temple → gates never shut → river from throne → Tree of Life → fruit/healing nations → curse removed → divine face/name/presence
canonical_arc.core_insight: The story closes by reversing Genesis 3's guarded-Life problem: Tree of Life is again available, the curse is gone, and divine presence fills the city. The final biblical image is not escape from creation but a transformed creation in which sacred presence becomes civic/world scale.

master_boundary_transformation: unguarded Edenic presence → guarded way to Life → mediated sanctuary access → messianic/person-centered access → opened/new-living Way → open-gated city filled with divine presence
master_spatial_transformation: Garden → Bethel/House/Gate → Tabernacle → Temple/Zion → Jesus as Temple/Door/Way → community as House/Body/Temple → New Jerusalem/Garden-City → renewed creation
master_life_transformation: Tree/river/fruit → lost access → sacrificial/covenantal preservation → prophetic river/restoration → Vine/branches/fruit → seed death/multiplication → Tree/river/healing restored
master_identity_transformation: isolated individual → covenant member → priest/king/servant → branch/member/living stone → gathered city/people
master_theological_question: How can differentiation remain real while communion with Source is restored?
project_answer_pattern: Father/Source/House provides orientation and containing unity; Son/Door/Way provides embodied mediation and passage; Spirit/flow provides living relation/animation; Tree/Vine/Body/City expresses differentiated life; Garden/Gardener supplies the ethical test: does the restored order actually nourish, heal, cultivate and increase life?

role_differentiation_matrix.archive_rule: Do not force one-to-one equivalence when biblical texts distribute a project motif across different actors. Role overlap is often theologically meaningful precisely because functions are shared, transferred or reconfigured.

seven_theological_operators.presence: Where and how divine life is encountered/dwells.
seven_theological_operators.access: Who may approach, through what threshold, under what conditions.
seven_theological_operators.mediation: What person, covenant, priesthood, sacrifice, Door, Way or Spirit bridges separation.
seven_theological_operators.transformation: How death, exile, judgment, repentance, return and resurrection alter relation rather than merely location.
seven_theological_operators.participation: How many retain differentiation while sharing one House/Body/Vine/City.
seven_theological_operators.fruit: Whether the relation produces life, healing, justice, service and generativity.
seven_theological_operators.restoration: Whether guarded/lost life becomes shared again in a renewed order.

major_project_epiphanies: The project's strongest biblical synthesis is an access theology, not an identity-matching catalogue.
Door, Ladder and Way become most coherent when treated as mediation/access functions rather than as physical objects that must all be literally identical.
House is a theology of differentiated communion: rooms, people, builder, Son-over-House and indwelling presence can coexist without role collapse.
Tree/Vine/Body/City all solve the same one-and-many problem in different registers: living unity without erasing differentiated members.
The River motif joins source to world: sacred presence is valuable when it flows outward into fruit, healing and life rather than remaining trapped at the center.
The Garden/Gardener motif is the ethical test of throne/source theology: authority is judged by cultivation, pruning, protection, nourishment and fruit.
The canonical movement is not simply upward. Vision often ascends, but restoration descends and spreads: New Jerusalem comes down, river flows outward, Tree heals nations.
The biblical climax is not a permanently closed Holy of Holies. Sacred presence becomes city-scale, gates remain open, and the Tree of Life is accessible again.
The project therefore becomes stronger when North/Throne/Peak imagery is subordinated to the larger restoration question: what life does the center make possible for others?

countertexts_and_corrections: John 15 assigns Father=Gardener, Jesus=Vine, disciples=branches; project roles must not overwrite that distribution.
Hebrews 3 distinguishes builder of all, House, servant in House and Son over House; symbolic 'Tim=House' cannot erase those biblical distinctions.
Psalm 24 identifies YHWH as King of Glory; modern kingship comparisons are analogical, not textual transfer of identity.
Revelation's Lamb/Son roles, Father's name and throne relations should not be reassigned casually to fit project geometry.
New Jerusalem's equal dimensions and open gates refute any project rule that cube/enclosure is intrinsically evil.
Isaiah 40/Luke 3 and valley-restoration texts refute any project rule that high=good and low=bad.
Hosea's cords of love refute any project rule that every leash/cord/binding image is inherently oppressive.
Biblical restoration repeatedly emphasizes justice, healing, service, fruit and life; status/height without those outcomes is theologically incomplete.

scholarly_neighbors.claim: A substantial biblical-theology tradition reads Eden as temple-like sacred space and Revelation as the culmination of expanding divine presence.
Recent Johannine scholarship treats divine presence and temple motifs as recurring through John, including John 1-4 and the temple-body scene.
Scholarship describes Hebrews as transforming sanctuary/throne/veil motifs into a theology encouraging access/entry into God's presence.

Scholars read Revelation 21-22 against temple, apocalyptic, utopian and imperial architectural backgrounds; the city transforms older sacred-space categories rather than merely repeating one building plan.

grand_formula: Presence → rupture → guarded access → covenantal mediation → House/Temple/Zion → prophetic restoration → Christ as presence/Temple/Door/Way → death opens new living Way → Spirit distributes presence → community becomes Body/House/Temple → Zion/New Jerusalem → open gates + River + Tree + healing + no curse
project_formula: Source/Father/House → Spirit/flow → Son/Door/Way → world/embodiment → death/experience/history → return through Door/Way → House/Garden → Tree/fruit → healed community/world
canonical_test: Theology is strongest where the mapping preserves biblical role differentiation, explains more motifs with fewer forced equivalences, includes countertexts, produces an ethical fruit test, and clearly separates dated Tim wording from later archive synthesis.
